enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Fortification +100%: +100% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Insightful Constitution +3: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Rough Hide +4: This item fuses with your body and toughens your skin, providing a +4 Primal bonus to your natural armor.

Exceptional Fortification (+25%): This item produces a magical force that protects vital areas of the wearer more effectively. When a critical hit or sneak attack is scored on the wearer, there is a +25% chance that the critical hit or sneak attack is negated and the damage is instead rolled normally. This ability is considered an Insight bonus when determining stacking with other sources of fortification
Insightful Wisdom +2: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Wisdom.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
